Market today: The market mood is cautious, driven by surging U.S. Treasury yields hitting new highs. This is a direct headwind for your tech and chip names, as higher rates make future growth less attractive and increase borrowing costs.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down nearly 50% on a leveraged, decaying ETF. SPAL, another leveraged ETF, is also down over 36% shortly after you bought it. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH is also flagged for trimming, down over 10%.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields; continued increases will pressure your portfolio. Also, watch for any further news on chip sector pullbacks.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, losing positions given the current market headwinds.
plays: SOXL: Sell or significantly trim this leveraged ETF. Your -49.27% loss is substantial; cut exposure.
SPAL: Re-evaluate your stop at 21.38. This new, leveraged position is already down -36.54% and needs immediate attention.
SMH: Respect your stop at 540. Be prepared to trim if the chip sector continues its pullback.
